name: Steps
description: How it works: an ordered sequence of steps, each a title and a line of text with an optional image, as a vertical list or a row, numbered or plain.

layout.description: list: a vertical list. row: across the page. rail: one rail on the start side. alternate: items alternate either side of a centre rail from md (one rail on phones); DOM order stays chronological.

style.description: A number badge before each step, or an accent rule beside it.

kind.description: steps: a numbered sequence. timeline: a date per item on a vertical rail (the rail layouts below; without a layout it uses rail).

marker.description: What sits on the rail: the style's number badge, or a plain dot (the timeline default). Not yet: icon and date markers, and a visual emphasis for the current item (it has aria-current and a hidden label only).

connector.description: The rail between items on the rail layouts.

intro.label: Intro
intro.description: A line or two under the heading.

items.label: Steps

number.label: Number
number.description: The step's number as the source writes it (01, Step 2); empty: the list counts 1, 2, 3.

imageAlt.label: Image description
imageAlt.description: What the image shows; empty if decorative.

date.label: Date
date.description: A timeline's date as written ("2019", "Mar 2021"); marked up as a <time> only when it is an ISO date or a year.

current.label: Current
current.description: Marks the latest item (aria-current="step" and a hidden "Current").

items.description: The steps, in order (Elementor icon boxes, Divi blurbs, Gutenberg columns of heading + text).

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

currentLabel.description: Visually hidden text on the current item, so it is not shown by colour alone.

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour or linear/radial gradient laid over the image or the fill.

size.description: cover, contain or auto; anything else draws as cover.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

align.description: Where the heading and lead sit; read by a component whose own align is not set.

a11y: Steps are an <ol>, so their order and count are announced; the visible numbers are CSS counters, not text. Each title is an <h3> under the section's <h2>, or an <h2> when the section has no heading. The section is labelled by its heading when it has one. A timeline is the same <ol>; a date is a <time datetime> only when machine-readable; the rail and dots are CSS and not in the accessibility tree.

pattern.summary: ordered sequence: numbered title + short text units
